reason: A browser-panel utility for exporting and incrementally restoring DSH plugins, custom skills, and configuration files as JSON snapshots; review is warranted because snapshots may contain credentials and restoration writes files and reinstalls plugins.

summaries.zh: 在浏览器设置面板中将 DSH 插件、技能和配置导出为 JSON 快照，并按需增量还原。
summaries.en: A browser-panel utility that exports DSH plugins, skills, and configuration into JSON snapshots and incrementally restores them when needed.

capabilities: Exports installed plugin metadata, custom skills, and configuration files into JSON snapshots
May include API keys and other sensitive credentials in exported snapshots
Reads and writes files under the DSH configuration and skills directories
Reinstalls missing plugins and updates plugin configuration during restore
Downloads and imports snapshot files through a browser settings panel
